title: Bills QB Josh Allen earns first overtime win of career vs. Rams on MNF - ESPN
description: Josh Allen came through with his usual late-game theatrics in leading the Bills to a 37-34 overtime win against the Rams on "Monday Night Football," breaking his careerlong winless streak in OT.

title: RJ Mitte, 'Breaking Bad' actor and disability rights champion, dies at 34 - NPR
description: Actor and disability rights advocate RJ Mitte, who brought a lifetime of experience with cerebral palsy to fictional family struggles in an essential role on "Breaking Bad," died Monday at age 34.
